records.rationale: The packet contains the ClaimsPro intake record (intake.md), the status history (status_history.md), the adjuster notes (adjuster_notes.md) and two damage photos (IMG_0071.jpg, IMG_0072.jpg). The photos show front-left bumper, fender and headlamp damage, matching the adjuster's description of a low-speed single-vehicle incident. The required repair estimate is missing, so nothing on file supports the $2,825.07 claimed. The date of loss and the policy period are blank, so coverage on the date of loss cannot be checked from the file and must be confirmed in ClaimsPro. The intake record shows a disposition of 'Paid in Full', which contradicts the status history (last status 'Assigned') and the adjuster's note that the estimate is needed before the claim proceeds. The claim is routed to request the estimate from the shop and the date of loss from the policyholder, and to have a person check the recorded disposition. No denial indicator is supported by the evidence on file.
